# Code of conduct

monkeyread wants to be a friendly place for everyone, whatever their experience, background or identity.

## Expected behavior

- Be kind and patient, especially with newcomers.
- Give and take feedback on the work, not the person.
- Assume good intent, and ask before assuming.

## Not tolerated

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory jokes and language.
- Personal attacks, trolling, or deliberately derailing discussions.
- Sharing someone's private information without their consent.
- Sexualized language or imagery.

## Scope

This applies to every project space: issues, pull requests, discussions, and the public profiles and usernames on monkeyread itself.

## Enforcement

Report a problem to the maintainer, [@damien-mathieu1](https://github.com/damien-mathieu1), by the contact details on their GitHub profile. Reports are handled privately.

The maintainer may edit or remove content, and warn, temporarily ban or permanently ban anyone who breaks this code.

This code is inspired by the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org).
